evals.name: smart-home-insurance
evals.prompt: We design products for a home insurer. Create a design fiction about home insurance in a future where every home is fully sensor-monitored.
evals.expected_output: A design fiction: a concrete artifact or prop from that future (not a report about it), the everyday context it lives in, what it makes discussable, and the questions it raises for the team now.

evals.name: ai-tutor-school
evals.prompt: Our edtech team is designing an AI tutor for secondary schools. Use design fiction to help teachers and parents discuss what it could become.
evals.expected_output: One or more design fiction artifacts showing the AI tutor in ordinary use in a plausible near future, the conversations it is meant to provoke, how to use it with teachers and parents, and what it leaves open.

evals.name: neighbourhood-energy
evals.prompt: A utility wants to explore neighbourhood energy sharing. Make a design fiction we can show in a stakeholder meeting next week.
evals.expected_output: A tangible design fiction artifact (for example a product, notice, manual page, advert or interface) from a world with neighbourhood energy sharing, its backstory, how to present it, and questions it opens up.
